type Id = string | number;
function show<T extends Id>(xs: T[]): string {
  return xs.map((x) => x.toString()).join();
}
function longest<T extends string | any[]>(a: T, b: T): T {
  return a.length >= b.length ? a : b;
}
function readA<T extends { a: number } | { a: string }>(x: T): number | string {
  const { a } = x;
  return x.a ?? a;
}
function size<T extends string[] | number[]>(x: T): number {
  return x.map((v) => v).length + x.length;
}
function call<T extends (() => number) | (() => string)>(f: T): number | string {
  return f();
}
function method<T extends { m(): number } | { m(): string }>(x: T): number | string {
  return x.m();
}
function maybe<T extends { a?: number } | { a: string }>(x: T): number | string | undefined {
  return x.a;
}
function nested<T extends string | number, U extends T>(x: U): string {
  return x.toString();
}
function write<T extends { a: number } | { a: string }>(x: T): T {
  x.a = 3;
  return x;
}
console.log(show([1, "x"]), longest("ab", "c"), longest([1], [2, 3]));
console.log(readA({ a: "s" }), size([1, 2]), call(() => 1), method({ m: () => "m" }));
console.log(maybe({}), nested<string, "n">("n"), write({ a: "w" }));
